subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Which stable Feishu bot/account discriminator should be part of durable group session identity, and how should existing Feishu group histories be migrated or repaired?
rationale: The fix crosses a durable session-key and authorization boundary; automation can identify the missing discriminator but cannot choose the compatibility and security tradeoff safely.

options.title: Account-scoped group sessions with migration
options.body: Include the normalized OpenClaw Feishu account boundary in group session identity and provide doctor or migration handling for existing group keys.

options.title: Platform identity scoped sessions
options.body: Use a Feishu platform identity such as appId or a proven bot identity if maintainers prefer platform semantics over OpenClaw account ids.

options.title: Defer for broader Feishu identity design
options.body: Keep this issue open while related Feishu mention, context, and DM identity work converge on one shared model.

recommendation.title: Account-scoped group sessions with migration
recommendation.body: Include the normalized OpenClaw Feishu account boundary in group session identity and provide doctor or migration handling for existing group keys.

likelyOwner.reason: They are already referenced in the existing review as the likely reviewer for the adjacent Feishu multi-bot identity decision, and the release-provenance commit is in their recent history.
